sentences.l2: 对许多北漂来说，合租几乎是初到这座城市时无法回避的选择。
sentences.l1: For many Beijing drifters, sharing a flat is almost an unavoidable choice when first arriving in this city.

sentences.l2: 独自租房的开支往往占去收入的大半，合租则能把生活成本压到可以承受的范围。
sentences.l1: The expense of renting alone often takes up most of one's income, while sharing a flat can press living costs down to a bearable range.

sentences.l2: 一套原本给三口之家设计的旧公寓，被房东用石膏板隔出四五间不足十平米的隔断间，每间只容得下一张床和一张桌子。
sentences.l1: An old apartment originally designed for a family of three is partitioned by the landlord with plasterboard into four or five partition rooms of under ten square metres, each of which holds only a bed and a desk.

sentences.l2: 合租带来的不只是省钱。
sentences.l1: What sharing a flat brings is not only savings.

sentences.l2: 当客厅、厨房和卫生间被四五个人共享，个人隐私便让位于彼此迁就：谁先用洗手间、谁该倒垃圾、深夜归来的脚步声有多响，都成了需要反复协商的议题。
sentences.l1: When the living room, kitchen and bathroom are shared by four or five people, personal privacy gives way to mutual accommodation: who uses the bathroom first, who should take out the rubbish, how loud the footsteps of someone coming home late at night are, have all become topics that need repeated negotiation.

sentences.l2: 许多室友从素不相识到逐渐熟悉，会分享家乡的食物，也会在对方加班时留一盏灯。
sentences.l1: Many flatmates go from being complete strangers to gradually becoming familiar, will share food from their hometowns, and will also leave a light on when the other works overtime.

sentences.l2: 也有人始终维持着礼貌的距离，同住一年却说不清对方的职业。
sentences.l1: There are also people who always maintain a polite distance, and after living together for a year cannot say clearly what the other's job is.

sentences.l2: 这种疏离未必是冷漠，更像是一种自我保护——毕竟下一次涨租，随时可能让人搬走。
sentences.l1: This aloofness is not necessarily indifference, and is more like a kind of self-protection -- after all, the next rent increase may force one to move out at any time.
